		}

	dynamic_country_name = {
		name = lp_dyn_c_ddr_name
		adjective = GER_ADJ
		is_main_tag_only = yes
		priority = 15
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:actor
			scope:actor ?= {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_single_party_state
						py:communist_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_in_government = yes
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						OR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_technocracy
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
							AND = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proletariat_dictatorship
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_election
							}
						}
						ruler ?= {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						is_subject = yes
						overlord = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_parliamentary_republic
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_presidential_republic
				}
			}
		}
	}
	dynamic_country_name = {
		name = lp_dyn_c_deutsches_reich

		is_main_tag_only = yes
		priority = 15
		trigger = {
			coa_def_fascist_flag_trigger = yes
		}
	}
}

# JAP
REPLACE:JAP = { # Japan
	dynamic_country_name = {
		name = dyn_c_tokugawa_shogunate
		adjective = JAP_ADJ
		is_main_tag_only = yes
		priority = 10
		trigger = {
			scope:actor ?= {
				country_has_monarchy_law = yes
				OR = {
					game_date < 1836.1.2
					var:bpm_headofgov ?= {
						has_variable = house_tokugawa
					}
				}
				has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
			}
		}
	}
	dynamic_country_name = {
		name = dyn_c_japanese_taikunate
		adjective = JAP_ADJ
		is_main_tag_only = yes
		priority = 25
		trigger = {
			scope:actor ?= {
				country_is_taikunate = yes
			}
			coa_def_communist_flag_trigger = yes
		}
		name = lp_dyn_c_japanese_peoples_republic
		priority = 40
	}
	dynamic_country_name = {
		name = dyn_c_empire_of_japan
		adjective = JAP_ADJ
		is_main_tag_only = yes
		priority = 20
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:actor
			scope:actor ?= {
				country_has_monarchy_law = yes
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
				}
			}
		}
	}
	dynamic_country_name = {
		name = dyn_c_republic_of_japan
		adjective = JAP_ADJ
		is_main_tag_only = yes
		priority = 30
		trigger = {
			exists = scope:actor
			coa_def_republic_flag_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	dynamic_country_name = {
		name = lp_dyn_c_peoples_republic_of_rising_sun
		adjective = lp_dyn_c_peoples_republic_of_rising_sun_adj
		is_main_tag_only = yes
		priority = 50
		trigger = {
			coa_def_communist_flag_trigger = yes
			exists = scope:actor
			scope:actor ?= {
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_technocracy
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
					AND = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proletariat_dictatorship
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_election
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_professional_army
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_mass_conscription
				}
				has_ruling_interest_group = ig_armed_forces
			}
		}
	}
}
